aiOverview.content: Ethan Lovett is a charismatic con artist on the ABC soap opera General Hospital, recognized as the biological son of legacy characters Luke Spencer and Holly Sutton. After a six-year absence, the character recently returned to Port Charles on April 17, 2026, portrayed by original actor Nathan Dean (formerly credited as Nathan Parsons).Nathan Dean Returning as Ethan Lovett to 'General Hospital ...Just JaredWhat Happened to Ethan on General Hospital? - Soap Opera DigestSoap Opera DigestGeneral Hospital Shocks Fans With Original Ethan Lovett's ReturnYahooGeneral Hospital' Announces Ethan Lovett Return - ParadeParadeGeneral Hospital' Brings Back Ethan Lovett as Nathan Dean ...Michael Fairman TVCharacter Profile and HistoryEthan first arrived in Port Charles in 2009 as a "charismatic drifter" and grifter. His debut storyline centered on a paternity mystery, initially suggesting he might be the son of either Luke Spencer or Robert Scorpio.Family Ties: He is the half-brother of Lucky Spencer and Lulu Spencer. Recently, it was revealed that he is also the half-brother of Sasha Gilmore through their mother, Holly.Key Relationships: Ethan is known for a complex history with Kristina Corinthos-Davis, who harbored a crush on him as a teenager. He was once married to Maya Ward following a drunken night in Las Vegas.Abuse Scandal: In a significant past storyline, Kristina falsely accused Ethan of assaulting her to protect her actual abuser, Kiefer Bauer. This led to Ethan being targeted by mob boss Sonny Corinthos before the truth was revealed.Actor and Return DetailsThe role was originated by Nathan Parsons in 2009. The actor now uses the professional name Nathan Dean, a choice he made during his time on Roswell, New Mexico to reinvent himself and pay homage to James Dean.Actor HistoryRecastCurrent 2026 StorylineEthan's April 2026 return coincided with his desire to pay respects following the off-screen death of his father, Luke Spencer (played by the late Anthony Geary). Upon his return, he immediately reconnected with his sister, Lulu. Spoilers suggest his return may involve helping Sonny Corinthos take down criminals Jenz Sidwell and Ross Cullum.
